items.title: Ida Goodson Interview, 1961-05-06
items.q: Ah! Jason! Listen, if it's the same thing that they say, it wouldn't be because they wouldn't want to be playing jazz.

ctx.x: They're turning over in their grave. Now that's a sin on the face.
Ah! Jason! Listen, if it's the same thing that they say, it wouldn't be because they wouldn't want to be playing jazz.
